zwiftverse — development handoff

Version: 0.1.0 (pre-check) Last authored: 2026-11-23 Purpose of this doc: bring a fresh session (Cowork or human) up to speed to test the package against the live APIs and continue development without re-deriving context.

TL;DR status

An R package wrapping three unofficial Zwift-ecosystem APIs (Zwift game, ZwiftPower, ZwiftRacing.app). Typed wrappers return tibbles; shared on-disk TTL cache; roxygen docs; CI + pkgdown workflows; one vignette.

What is done: structure, code, cache, NAMESPACE, tests (offline), CI YAML, pkgdown config, vignette.

What is NOT done — the gate before trusting anything: - Never run under a real R. Authored in an environment with no R toolchain, so this is static-checked only — not R CMD check-clean, tests not executed, never called against a live endpoint. - man/ is not generated (roxygen tags present; run devtools::document()). - Endpoint field names are partly assumed (see Risks). The vignette’s transmute()/hoist() column names are placeholders to be pinned against real responses.

Treat v0.1.0 as “compiles in my head, needs a real run.”

First actions (ordered)

# from the package root
install.packages(c("devtools","roxygen2","httr2","tibble","dplyr","rlang"))
devtools::document()      # generate man/ + refresh NAMESPACE from roxygen
devtools::test()          # offline tests: tibble converter + cache. Should pass.
devtools::check()         # expect a few NOTES/WARNINGS to clear — see below

Anticipated check() findings and fixes: - Undocumented ... on the @describeIn children → already documented on the parents (zwift_get, zp_get, zr_get); if roxygen still flags, add an explicit @param ... to each parent (harmless). - req_throttle(rate = …) is deprecated in httr2 ≥ 1.1 (still works, warns). Swap to capacity/fill_time_s in R/zwiftracing.R::.zr_req() once you confirm the installed httr2 version. - stats::setNames in zp_login() — fully qualified, should be fine; if NOTE, add @importFrom stats setNames. - Non-ASCII: README/vignette use em-dashes etc. (allowed); DESCRIPTION is clean.

Then live smoke tests, easiest auth first: 1. ZR (ZR_AUTH env var — simplest, single header). zr_rider(zr_client(), <known_id>). 2. Zwift (ZWIFT_USERNAME/ZWIFT_PASSWORD). zwift_profile(zwift_auth()). 3. ZP — use zp_set_cookie() with a browser-copied phpbb3_lswlk_sid first; only test zp_login() (SSO scrape) after.

For each endpoint: call with parse = "json", glimpse() the result, record the real field names, then confirm the tibble shape with parse = "tbl".

Known risks & unverified assumptions

# Assumption Source How to verify
1 ZP result/_view.json fields: zwid, position_in_cat, category, avg_wkg inferred zp_result(zp, id, parse="json") then str()
2 ZR rider nests ratings under race (current/max30/max90, rating, mixed$category) inferred from zpdatafetch zr_rider(zr, id, parse="json")
3 ZR id field is riderId inferred same
4 ZR auth = raw key in Authorization (no Bearer) — superseded, see results puckdoug/zpdatafetch source first live ZR call
5 ZR base https://api.zwiftracing.app/api puckdoug/zpdatafetch source first live ZR call
6 ZR batch POST body = bare JSON array of ints, ≤1000 source zr_riders() live
7 Zwift auth: secure.zwift.com/auth/realms/zwift/tokens/access/codes, client_id=Zwift_Mobile_Link, password grant well-established community value zwift_auth() live (Zwift has migrated auth before — this is the single most likely breakage)
8 ZP cookie name phpbb3_lswlk_sid source/community inspect browser cookies on zwiftpower.com
9 .zv_to_tbl() flattening is correct for deeply nested real payloads logic only assert shapes in tests once fixtures exist

Rule of thumb: anything marked “inferred” above must be confirmed before the vignette or downstream analysis is trusted.

Live verification results (2026-11-23)

# Result
1 ✅ Confirmed. zwid, position_in_cat, category, avg_wkg, name all present. Numbers come as [value, flag] pairs (value sometimes a string) → new zp_unflag(); vignette updated.
2 ❌ Wrong — API moved to v2. race now holds counts (finishes/wins/podiums/dnfs); the rating is velo$race (+ velo$factors). Legacy live/max30/max90 ratings are under /riders/{id}/overview → legacyRatings.
3 ✅ riderId.
4 ❌ Wrong. Key goes in an x-api-key header (not Authorization, with or without Bearer).
5 ❌ v1 /api/public/* routes return 401 for this key; everything is /api/v2/*. Responses wrap as {success, data}.
6 ❌ No batch endpoint in v2 → zr_riders() loops (throttled, cached).
7 ✅ Legacy tokens/access/codes + Zwift_Mobile_Link still works. OIDC fallback kept.
8 ⚠️ Partly. phpbb3_lswlk_sid works for api3.php, but cache3/*.json is now behind CloudFront signed cookies (403 MissingKey). Fixed: zp_get() loads a logged-in page to obtain them (re-primed every 30 min).

Other live findings, all fixed: - Zwift accepts "me" only on /api/profiles/me; sub-resources (activities, followers, followees, rideons) 404 → wrappers now resolve "me" to the id. - Zwift activity ids exceed 2^53 → parsed with bigint_as_char = TRUE. - ZwiftPower api3.php serves JSON as text/html → parse with check_type = FALSE.

ZwiftRacing client rewritten for v2: zr_rider, zr_rider_overview, zr_rider_results, zr_rider_ranking, zr_rider_velo, zr_rider_power, zr_riders, zr_event, zr_result (event pens → one row per rider, incl. ratingBefore/rating/riderVelo.race), zr_club, zr_club_riders (0-based ?page=, 50/page, auto-pages), zr_routes. Removed: zr_post, zr_categories, epoch (v2 has no snapshot endpoint; use zr_rider_velo()).

Fixtures recorded for all 21 endpoints (scrubbed, arrays ≤25 at any depth, ~770 KB). 65 tests pass, 0 skip. Vignette pipeline (sections 1–3) run live end-to-end on 2026-11-23.

Recommended next step: fixture-based tests

The biggest fragility is parsing real payload shapes with no offline way to test them. Fix that first:

  1. Add httptest2 (Suggests).
  2. Make one authenticated call per endpoint and record with httptest2::capture_requests({ ... }) → saves sanitised JSON fixtures under tests/testthat/.
  3. Scrub rider PII from fixtures before committing (names, ids → synthetic).
  4. Wrap the parsing tests in with_mock_api() so CI tests .zv_to_tbl() against real shapes without credentials or network.

This turns “I think the columns are right” into a regression guard and makes the green CI badge meaningful.

Live testing quick-start

Put credentials + target ids in a gitignored .Renviron (vars documented at the top of dev/endpoints.R), restart R, then from the package root:

Rscript dev/smoke-live.R        # pass/fail + field names per endpoint, no values
Rscript dev/capture-fixtures.R  # writes scrubbed fixtures -> tests/testthat/fixtures
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'   # fixture tests now run instead of skipping

P1 — completeness & robustness - [x] Swap req_throttle(rate=) → capacity/fill_time_s (httr2’s req_retry already honours Retry-After). - [x] Pagination: zwift_activities/followers/followees take limit as the total wanted and page internally at the server maximum (activities 50, follows 200; larger → HTTP 400 limit.too.large). limit = Inf = all. Followers/followees now default to all. Multi-page + parse = "json" errors (one response can’t represent several). Generic .zv_paged() + type-tolerant .zv_bind() in R/utils.R. - [x] Zwift event results: zwift_event_subgroups(), zwift_subgroup_results() / zwift_event_results() (/api/race-results/entries?event_subgroup_id=, {entries}, paged at 50 — a 200-row page drew a 429), zwift_subgroup_entrants() / zwift_event_entrants() (/api/events/subgroups/entrants/{id}?participation=signed_up&type=all; joined is rejected). Verified live: 147 results across A–D matches ZwiftPower’s 147 finishers. - [x] Cache key for zr_riders — moot in v2 (per-rider requests).

P2 — polish - [ ] Token-refresh edge cases (clock skew, refresh-expiry races) in zwift_auth. - [ ] Optional memoise in-session layer over the disk cache. - [ ] README badges, NEWS.md, LICENSE.md, URL/BugReports in DESCRIPTION. - [ ] pkgdown: set url:, enable GitHub Pages → gh-pages.

P3 — distribution - [ ] Wrap examples in \dontrun{} (all need creds); add @examples. - [ ] CRAN pre-flight if ever intended (unlikely given unofficial APIs — more likely r-universe / GitHub only).

Architecture (so you don’t have to reverse-engineer it)

  • R/cache.R::.zv_fetch(req, parse, ttl) is the single choke point. Every low-level accessor builds an httr2 req and hands it here. It: bypasses on parse="resp"; else computes a cache key (method + url + body hash via rlang::hash), serves a fresh cache hit, otherwise performs → parses JSON (simplifyVector/DataFrame + flatten) → caches → returns tbl/json.
  • .zv_to_tbl() (R/utils.R): data.frame → tibble; {data:[...]} envelope unwrapped; bare array → row-bind; single object → one-row tibble with nested fields as list-columns (user tidyr::unnest_wider/hoist).
  • Three auth models, one per file: zwift_auth() (OAuth2 handle, auto-refresh, env ZWIFT_USERNAME/PASSWORD); zp_session() + cookie (env creds for SSO, or pasted sid); zr_client() (static key, env ZR_AUTH).
  • Typed wrappers forward ... to the low-level *_get, so parse=/ttl= flow through without per-wrapper plumbing.
  • TTL semantics: 0=off, Inf=permanent (immutable: completed results, historical epoch), n=seconds. Per-API defaults via options(zwiftverse.ttl_zwift/zp/zr).

Provenance

Endpoints verified by reading github.com/puckdoug/zpdatafetch (the Python reference for all three APIs). Zwift game-API surface cross-referenced to github.com/strukturunion-mmw/zwift-api-documentation. Nothing here used a leaked key — ZR is wired for the user’s own pending key.

Compliance / security (do not skip)

  • Zwift + ZP auth use the athlete’s real password, not a revocable token — never commit creds; use env vars or keyring. Fixtures must be PII-scrubbed.
  • Data is GDPR-consent-gated: non-consenting riders simply won’t appear; don’t treat absence as error.
  • Unofficial APIs: expect breakage on upstream releases; fine for personal/ research use, think harder before anything that redistributes others’ data.
